title: Gospel chapter with source notes
description: A verse beside its source tag and note, in the chapter-and-verse layout of the 1985 edition. Three worked verses from the annunciation and the boyhood; duplicate a row per verse.
content: The annunciation and the birth of Jesus

1Behold! the angels said, O Mary! God giveth thee glad tidings of a Word from Him: his name will be the Messiah, Jesus the son of Mary, held in honour in this world and the Hereafter, and of those nearest to God.1
Q 3:45; see also 19:16-21. Cf. Luke 1:26-33, where the angel is named Gabriel and the child is called Son of the Most High; the Qur’an calls him a Word from God and the Messiah.

2And when he was twelve years old they went up to Jerusalem for the feast, and after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both hearing them and asking them questions; and all that heard him were astonished at his understanding.2
Luke 2:41-47. Kept under rule 1 of the measure: it agrees with the Qur’an, which says God taught him the Book and wisdom (3:48) and that he spoke with wisdom from the cradle (5:110).
3And he went down with them to Nazareth, and grew in wisdom and in stature, and in favour with God and with the people.
A bridge from the boyhood to the ministry, after Luke 2:51-52. No claim beyond the 2 verses it joins.
